pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the primary trade has achieved a minimum floating profit of +$10.00 and stop-loss is locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce ATR-based volatility buffer: initial stop-loss must be set at least 1.5x the current 5-period ATR away from entry to prevent micro-wick stop hunts.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$15.00, trail remaining runner aggressively to target +$30.00.
